# scripts/PlayerUtils/TraversalScanner.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/TraversalScanner.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Measures traversal geometry and checks capsule clearance without moving the body.
Call setup() before querying. Body origins use the standing capsule centre;
crouched queries lower their centre to keep the feet at the same position.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.

### scan_from

```gdscript
func scan_from( origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, velocity: Vector3, airborne: bool, lookahead_time := -1.0, max_top_y := INF ) -> ObstacleProfile
```

[Source:92](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/TraversalScanner.gd#L92)

Scans at world body origin with forward direction and world velocity.
Negative lookahead_time uses scan_lookahead_time; max_top_y limits world top height.
Returns null on rejection and updates last_reject; never moves the body.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `origin` | `Vector3` | required |
| `direction` | `Vector3` | required |
| `velocity` | `Vector3` | required |
| `airborne` | `bool` | required |
| `lookahead_time` | `inferred from default` | `-1.0` |
| `max_top_y` | `inferred from default` | `INF` |

Return type: `ObstacleProfile`.

### ray

```gdscript
func ray(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, hit_back_faces := true) -> Dictionary
```

[Source:480](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/TraversalScanner.gd#L480)

Returns a Godot ray-hit Dictionary, or {} on miss. Excludes player/extra_exclude;
uses mask, solid bodies only, and does not detect hits from inside geometry.

```gdscript
func motion_is_clear(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, crouched: bool) -> bool
```

```gdscript

```
